full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D06E.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
STRUCTURAL READING AID:
1. All FOUR witnesses compared. Choose coherent THX/DYC whole form: central three-bar/stem component with TWO completely detached outer descending side legs. No closed counter.
2. Center stem starts ON shortish upper horizontal, crosses a slightly longer second horizontal close below, then descends much farther to END ON a SHORT lower FOOT horizontal. Foot is only about60–70% the second bar's length; no center stem protrudes below it.
3. Two upper bars close together; the gap from second bar to central lower foot is distinctly greater. Do not turn lower foot into a full-width baseline.
4. LEFT outer leg has a free upper-inner tip below second bar, curves outward left, descends and ends freely lower than center foot. RIGHT outer leg mirrors that rounded outward course and ends below foot. Both legs are entirely separate from center component and each other.
5. Lower foot's two ends stop well SHORT of outer legs with visible gaps. No joining of outer legs across bottom; no joining of side tips to upper bars. Total THREE independent ink components in this detached attested form.
6. Real even monoline tube strokes; straight parallel-sided bars and semicircular caps. Discard brush pressure/taper in reference.
Critical: TWO independent outer legs, BOTH free at BOTH ends; central stem ENDS on a narrow foot bar ABOVE their bottom ends. All three components separated, NO closed counter. Preserve a coherent complete detached THX/DYC arrangement after comparing CCZ/QJZ connection variants, rather than merging variants.
